brief:
EXECUTIVE BRIEF: Project Phoenix: Renewal Intelligence System
Our B2B SaaS ARR growth has decelerated because net revenue retention fell from 108% to 91% over the past four quarters. Account Managers (AMs) and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) report being blindsided by account cancellations.

Critical signals are fragmented across the enterprise:
- Contract values, renewal milestones, and terms reside in Salesforce CRM.
- Product telemetry and daily active user seats reside in Snowflake.
- Customer sentiment, complaints, and ticket escalations reside in Zendesk.
- Relationship nuances are trapped in Account Managers' private email threads.

Sales leadership insists on an 'AI-powered real-time churn prediction engine' that automatically notifies managers and triggers interventions before customers cancel. Meanwhile, Customer Success insists that no automated outreach should ever occur without mandatory human sign-off from the dedicated CSM. Data Engineering warns that product telemetry is refreshed only as a 24-hour nightly batch, making sub-minute 'real-time' monitoring architecturally questionable.

nodes.title: Restore Net Revenue Retention to 105%+
nodes.description: Reclaim trailing 4-quarter NRR from 91% to 105%+ by mitigating preventable SaaS account cancellations.

nodes.title: Fragmented Customer Risk Telemetry
nodes.description: Account health signals are siloed across CRM, product telemetry, Zendesk tickets, and email threads.

metadata.business_impact: CSMs miss leading churn indicators, leaving inadequate runway for interventions.

nodes.title: Customer Success Leadership
nodes.description: Accountable for gross retention, customer health indexing, and churn mitigation.

nodes.title: Account Management Team
nodes.description: Frontline owners of renewal commercial quotas, pricing negotiations, and upsell pipelines.

nodes.title: Identify Renewal Risk >=60 Days in Advance
nodes.description: Provide synthesized early warning indicators to AMs with sufficient operational lead time to intervene.

nodes.title: Multi-Source Risk Classification Engine
nodes.description: System shall evaluate accounts daily against composite telemetry, ticket escalations, and commercial indicators.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account with a 30% drop in active seats over 14 days, when daily evaluation executes, then health status shifts to AT_RISK.
System provides traceable evidence citations for all risk score calculations.

nodes.title: Autonomous Real-Time Intervention Triggering
nodes.description: System shall monitor accounts in real-time and automatically trigger customer outreach without delay.
conflict_notes: Directly conflicts with REQ-003 (Mandatory Human Sign-off)

nodes.title: Mandatory Human Review Gate for Interventions
nodes.description: All outreach, concession offers, and retention plans must be manually reviewed and approved by the assigned CSM.
acceptance_criteria: No communication shall dispatch to customer contacts without an authenticated CSM digital sign-off.
conflict_notes: Directly conflicts with REQ-002 (Autonomous Intervention Triggering)

nodes.title: Salesforce CRM
nodes.description: Source of truth for account owners, contract dates, ARR, and commercial terms.

nodes.title: Snowflake Telemetry Store
nodes.description: Contains daily active seats, feature usage logs, and workspace activities.

nodes.title: Zendesk Support Tickets
nodes.description: Support escalation tickets, CSAT scores, and ticket turnaround times.

nodes.title: Risk Scoring Service
nodes.description: Inference service computing composite health scores using rules and statistical anomaly detection.

nodes.title: CSM Intervention Console
nodes.description: Web portal allowing account teams to inspect evidence, adjust risk weights, and authorize playbooks.

nodes.title: Daily Telemetry & Sentiment Join
nodes.description: Nightly pipeline pulls Snowflake usage metrics and joins against active Salesforce contracts.

nodes.title: CSM Risk Review & Approval
nodes.description: CSM logs into console, inspects flagged account evidence, and authorizes customized intervention.

nodes.title: Verify Risk Classification Evidence Attribution
nodes.description: Ensure every risk notification exposes verifiable audit data points.
nodes.given: An account with a 40% seat usage drop over 14 days and 2 open Zendesk escalations
nodes.then: Account state transitions to 'HIGH_RISK' and cites seat drop and open tickets as direct evidence.

nodes.title: Operational Definition of 'Real-Time'
nodes.description: Does the business require sub-minute streaming alerts, or is a daily 24-hour batch refresh acceptable?
nodes.impact_description: Determines whether architecture requires an Apache Kafka streaming backbone or a warehouse query.

nodes.title: PII Redaction Strategy for Support Notes
nodes.description: Are free-form customer complaint notes permissible inside the ML feature store without masking?
nodes.impact_description: Determines regulatory GDPR/CCPA boundary and DLP pipeline necessity.

nodes.title: 24-Hour Telemetry Freshness Adequacy
nodes.description: Assumes 24-hour telemetry batch latency is sufficient to catch renewal churn patterns.
nodes.validation_path: Confirm typical enterprise B2B churn signal latency with Customer Success leadership.

nodes.title: Human-in-the-Loop Intervention Protocol
nodes.description: System generates recommended playbooks; frontline CSM retains sole authorization to trigger outreach.
nodes.tradeoff_summary: Eliminates risk of unreviewed automated outreach while maintaining structured intervention.

blockers: TEST BLOCKER: Under 50% test coverage for defined requirements.
